text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, although I revamped my chassis...
the results are merely so-so, it seems.
choice_data_list: But it seemed like it was working...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. The time wasn't too bad either.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems my read was on the mark after all.
It did yield a fair amount of results.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
However, next time I expect even greater heights.
Shall we schedule the next Upgrade Exam
for the end of the year in December?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As ST-2 said that, the light in its eyes
felt unmistakably like the shining embodiment
of Dr. Wright's will.
